name: @oc/adapter-core
description: The OC-aware per-turn adapter core shared by all Durable Agent Sessions runtimes (design 011 §5.3): durable event spool + idempotent append (fenced), resident-brain supervision, the localhost MCP tool host, skills materialization, and the turn driver that streams a brain's native NDJSON through a per-runtime translate(). Runtimes contribute a RuntimeSpec (model default, input filter/renderer, translate, steering text, skills layout, tool subset) and nothing else.
